<#
.SYNOPSIS
  Coordinates nonblocking standard display generation and verified publication.
.NOTES
  Authors: Rolf, Copilot
  Version: 10.0.1
  Date: 2026-10-21
#>
Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Import-Module -Name (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'LcmDisplayDependencies.psm1')
$script:Displays = @{}

function Get-LcmDisplayState {
  [CmdletBinding()]
  param([string]$DisplayId, [string]$WorkspaceRoot = 'D:\Git_Repositories')
  if (-not $script:Displays.ContainsKey($DisplayId)) {
    $definitions = Get-LcmDisplayDefinitions -WorkspaceRoot $WorkspaceRoot
    if (-not $definitions.ContainsKey($DisplayId)) { throw "Unknown standard display: $DisplayId" }
    $script:Displays[$DisplayId] = @{
      Id = $DisplayId; Definition = $definitions[$DisplayId]; State = 'Stale'
      Revision = ''; DataRevision = ''; PresentationRevision = ''; Error = ''
      Job = $null; Bytes = $null; CheckedAt = [datetime]::MinValue; Requested = $true
      DataInput = ''; PresentationInput = ''; StartedInput = ''; StartedPresentation = ''
      OperationId = ''; LogPath = ''; PublishedAt = ''
      FailedInput = ''
      StartedAt = [datetime]::MinValue
    }
  }
  return $script:Displays[$DisplayId]
}

function Update-LcmDisplayPublication {
  [CmdletBinding()]
  param([string]$DisplayId, [switch]$Refresh, [string]$WorkspaceRoot = 'D:\Git_Repositories')
  $state = Get-LcmDisplayState -DisplayId $DisplayId -WorkspaceRoot $WorkspaceRoot
  if ($Refresh) { $state.Requested = $true }
  if ($null -ne $state.Job -and -not $state.Job.HasExited -and ([datetime]::UtcNow - $state.StartedAt).TotalSeconds -gt 120) {
    $state.Job.Kill($true)
    $state.Job.WaitForExit()
    $state.Job.Dispose(); $state.Job = $null
    $state.State = 'Failed'; $state.Error = "Renderer exceeded 120 seconds. Log: $($state.LogPath)"
    $state.FailedInput = "$($state.DataInput).$($state.PresentationInput)"; $state.Requested = $false
    return $state
  }
  if ($Refresh -or ([datetime]::UtcNow - $state.CheckedAt).TotalSeconds -ge 2) {
    $state.DataInput = Get-LcmDisplayFingerprint -Paths $state.Definition.Data
    $state.PresentationInput = Get-LcmDisplayFingerprint -Paths $state.Definition.Presentation
    $state.CheckedAt = [datetime]::UtcNow
  }
  if ($null -ne $state.Job -and $state.Job.HasExited) {
    $exitCode = $state.Job.ExitCode
    $state.Job.Dispose()
    $state.Job = $null
    if ($exitCode -ne 0) {
      $state.State = 'Failed'
      $state.Error = "Renderer exited with code $exitCode. Log: $($state.LogPath)"
      $state.Requested = $false; $state.FailedInput = "$($state.DataInput).$($state.PresentationInput)"
      return $state
    }
    # Recheck after completion: never label an obsolete input revision as current.
    $dataNow = Get-LcmDisplayFingerprint -Paths $state.Definition.Data
    $presentationNow = Get-LcmDisplayFingerprint -Paths $state.Definition.Presentation
    $sourceNow = Get-LcmDisplayFingerprint -Paths $state.Definition.Source
    $artifact = $state.Definition.Artifact
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $artifact -PathType Leaf)) {
      $state.State = 'Failed'; $state.Error = "Renderer did not produce $artifact"
      $state.FailedInput = "$($state.DataInput).$($state.PresentationInput)"; $state.Requested = $false
      return $state
    }
    $html = [IO.File]::ReadAllText($artifact)
    if ($html -notmatch '(?i)<html\b' -or $html -match '(?i)(?:src|href)\s*=\s*["'']file:') {
      $state.State = 'Failed'; $state.Error = 'Rendered page is invalid or contains browser-facing file URLs.'
      $state.FailedInput = "$($state.DataInput).$($state.PresentationInput)"; $state.Requested = $false
      return $state
    }
    if ($presentationNow -ne $state.StartedPresentation -or $sourceNow -ne $state.StartedInput) {
      $state.Requested = $true
    } else {
      $state.Bytes = [Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false).GetBytes($html)
      $state.DataRevision = $dataNow
      $state.PresentationRevision = $presentationNow
      $state.Revision = "$dataNow.$presentationNow"
      $state.PublishedAt = [datetime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
      $state.State = 'Current'; $state.Error = ''; $state.Requested = $false
    }
    $state.DataInput = $dataNow; $state.PresentationInput = $presentationNow
  }
  $changed = $state.DataRevision -ne $state.DataInput -or $state.PresentationRevision -ne $state.PresentationInput
  $newInput = "$($state.DataInput).$($state.PresentationInput)" -ne $state.FailedInput
  if ($null -eq $state.Job -and ($state.Requested -or ($changed -and ($state.State -ne 'Failed' -or $newInput)))) {
    $state.OperationId = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')
    $logDir = Join-Path $WorkspaceRoot 'LCM_Inventory\data\logs\displays'
    $null = [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($logDir)
    $state.LogPath = Join-Path $logDir "$DisplayId-$($state.OperationId).log"
    $worker = Join-Path $WorkspaceRoot 'LCM_Inventory\tools\Invoke-LcmDisplayRender.ps1'
    $psi = [Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo]::new('pwsh.exe')
    $psi.UseShellExecute = $false; $psi.CreateNoWindow = $true
    foreach ($argument in @('-NoProfile','-File',$worker,'-DisplayId',$DisplayId,'-LogPath',$state.LogPath)) { $psi.ArgumentList.Add($argument) }
    $state.StartedInput = Get-LcmDisplayFingerprint -Paths $state.Definition.Source
    $state.StartedPresentation = $state.PresentationInput

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

function Send-LcmDisplayResponse {
  [CmdletBinding()]
  param([object]$Response, [byte[]]$Bytes, [string]$ContentType, [int]$StatusCode = 200)
  $Response.StatusCode = $StatusCode
  $Response.ContentType = $ContentType
  $Response.Headers['Cache-Control'] = 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'
  $Response.Headers['X-Content-Type-Options'] = 'nosniff'
  if ($ContentType -like 'text/html*') {
    $Response.Headers['Content-Security-Policy'] = "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; frame-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'"
  }
  $Response.ContentLength64 = $Bytes.Length
  $Response.OutputStream.Write($Bytes, 0, $Bytes.Length)
  $Response.Close()
}

function Invoke-LcmDisplayHttpRequest {
  [CmdletBinding()]
  param([object]$Request, [object]$Response, [string]$WorkspaceRoot = 'D:\Git_Repositories')
  $path = $Request.Url.AbsolutePath.ToLowerInvariant().TrimEnd('/')
  $method = $Request.HttpMethod
  $root = Join-Path $WorkspaceRoot 'LCM_Inventory'
  $aliases = @{ '/tools'='tools'; '/rules'='rules'; '/inventory'='inventory'; '/hub'='hub'; '/control'='hub'; '/control_hub'='hub'; '/cm_control_hub.html'='hub'; '/dates'='dates'; '/cm_crp_dates'='dates'; '/cm_crp_dates.html'='dates' }
  $isDisplay = $aliases.ContainsKey($path) -or $path -like '/displays/*' -or $path -like '/assets/*' -or $path -like '/failure-analysis/*' -or $path -like '/snapshots/*'
  if (-not $isDisplay) { return $false }
  $bytes = $null; $contentType = 'application/json; charset=utf-8'; $code = 200
  try {
    if ($Request.LocalEndPoint.Port -ne 9876) { throw 'Standard Displays require port 9876.' }
    if ($method -eq 'GET' -and $path -match '^/assets/(?<name>[a-z0-9_.-]+)$') {
      $name = $Matches.name
      $allowed = @('standard-table-display.css','standardtabledisplay.css','lcmtoolcatalog.css','lcm-tool-explorer.js','lcm-table-engine.js','lcm-table-print-atom.js','lcm-display-freshness.js','failure-analysis.css','failure-analysis.js')
      if ($name -notin $allowed) { throw 'Unknown display asset.' }
      $leaf = if ($name -eq 'standard-table-display.css') { 'StandardTableDisplay.css' } else { $name }
      $file = Join-Path $root "assets\$leaf"
      $bytes = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($file)
      $contentType = if ($name.EndsWith('.css')) { 'text/css; charset=utf-8' } else { 'text/javascript; charset=utf-8' }
    } elseif ($method -eq 'GET' -and $path -match '^/(?<kind>failure-analysis|snapshots)/(?<id>[a-f0-9]{32})/(?<leaf>index\.html|report\.json|report\.md)$') {
      $file = Join-Path $root "data\artifacts\$($Matches.kind)\$($Matches.id)\$($Matches.leaf)"
      $leaf = $Matches.leaf
      $bytes = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($file)
      $contentType = switch ($leaf) { 'index.html' { 'text/html; charset=utf-8' }; 'report.json' { 'application/json; charset=utf-8' }; default { 'text/plain; charset=utf-8' } }
    } else {
      $kind = 'page'; $id = ''
      if ($aliases.ContainsKey($path) -and $method -eq 'GET') { $id = $aliases[$path] }
      elseif ($path -match '^/displays/(?<kind>status|content|data|refresh)/(?<id>tools|rules|inventory|hub|dates)$') {
        $kind = $Matches.kind; $id = $Matches.id
        if (($kind -eq 'refresh' -and $method -ne 'POST') -or ($kind -ne 'refresh' -and $method -ne 'GET')) { throw 'Invalid display request method.' }
      } else { throw 'Unknown display route.' }
      $state = Update-LcmDisplayPublication -DisplayId $id -Refresh:($kind -eq 'refresh') -WorkspaceRoot $WorkspaceRoot
      if ($kind -in @('status','refresh')) {
        $bytes = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes(((Get-LcmDisplayStatus -State $state) | ConvertTo-Json -Compress))
      } elseif ($kind -eq 'data' -and $null -ne $state.Bytes) {
        $html = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($state.Bytes)
        $payload = [regex]::Match($html, '(?is)<script\b(?=[^>]*\bid=["'']lcm-display-data["''])(?=[^>]*\btype=["'']application/json["''])[^>]*>(?<data>.*?)</script>')
        if (-not $payload.Success) { throw 'Published display has no structured data payload.' }
        $null = $payload.Groups['data'].Value | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop
        $Response.Headers['X-LCM-Display-Revision'] = $state.Revision
        $bytes = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($payload.Groups['data'].Value)
      } elseif ($null -ne $state.Bytes) {
        $Response.Headers['X-LCM-Display-Revision'] = $state.Revision
        $bytes = $state.Bytes; $contentType = 'text/html; charset=utf-8'
      } else {
        $code = 503
        $bytes = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes((@{ state=$state.State; error=$state.Error; statusUrl="/displays/status/$id" } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress))
      }
    }
  } catch {
    $code = if ($_.Exception -is [IO.FileNotFoundException] -or $_.Exception -is [IO.DirectoryNotFoundException]) { 404 } else { 500 }
    Write-Warning "Standard Display request '$path' failed: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    $bytes = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes((@{ error=$_.Exception.Message } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress))
  }
  Send-LcmDisplayResponse -Response $Response -Bytes $bytes -ContentType $contentType -StatusCode $code
  return $true
}

function Stop-LcmDisplayHttp {
  [CmdletBinding()]
  param()
  Stop-LcmDisplayPublication
}

function Get-LcmDisplayFingerprint {
  [CmdletBinding()]
  param([string[]]$Paths)
  $records = foreach ($path in $Paths) {
    $files = @(if (Test-Path -Path $path -ErrorAction Stop) { Get-ChildItem -Path $path -File -ErrorAction Stop })
    if (-not $files.Count) { "MISSING:$path"; continue }
    foreach ($file in $files | Sort-Object FullName) {
      "$($file.FullName):$((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $file.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash)"
    }
  }
  $bytes = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes(($records -join "`n"))
  [Convert]::ToHexString([Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::HashData($bytes)).ToLowerInvariant()
}

MACRO: learn
- description: record something learned as a candidate for LEARNED_ADVICE.md (RULE-CTX-005)
- syntax: /learn <text> | learn <text>
- rules:
  - add the text as a candidate with Save-AllSessionMemory.ps1 -Learn "<text>" -Author <AI name>; do nothing else
  - candidates are reviewed with Invoke-LearnedAdviceReview.ps1 no later than push (push is refused while any are pending)

MACRO: ToolExplorer
- description: generate and launch the authoritative LCM Tool Explorer interactive HTML application via Show-ToolsExplorer.ps1
- syntax: ToolExplorer [switches] | tools [switches] | ShowTools [switches]
- aliases: tools, ToolsExplorer, ShowTools
- primary target: LCM_Inventory/tools/Show-ToolsExplorer.ps1 (trampolines: LCM_Inventory/Cmd/ToolExplorer.cmd, ToolsExplorer.cmd)
- parameters:
  - -Audience <User|Dev|All>: pre-filter audience category (defaults to 'User')
  - -Group <Name>: pre-filter by group or subsystem (e.g. 'HaSSD06', 'LCM', 'SystemConfiguration')
  - -Subsystem <Name>: direct filter for specific subsystem (e.g. 'HaSSD06', 'LCM_Inventory')
  - -HaSSD06 (or -Ha): quick switch to filter directly to Home Assistant HaSSD06 tools
  - -Role <RoleName>: pre-filter by functional role (e.g. 'QualityGate', 'ReviewGate', 'Elevation', 'DesktopGUI')
  - -Tool <ToolName>: pre-select and highlight specific tool
  - -Env <PS1|CMD|PY|REG|LNK|All>: pre-filter by tool execution environment
  - -Filter <query>: initial text search keyword on startup (supports '!term' negation)
  - -NoBrowser (or -Cli, -Text): suppress browser and output catalog to terminal
  - -NoLaunch: generate HTML dashboard and cache without browser launch
  - -h (or -Help): display comprehensive parameter reference
- examples:
  - 'ToolExplorer' or 'tools' -> launches Tool Explorer filtered to Audience=User
  - 'ToolExplorer -Audience Dev' -> launches Tool Explorer filtered to internal developer tools
  - 'ToolExplorer -HaSSD06' -> launches Tool Explorer filtered to HaSSD06 subsystem
  - 'ToolExplorer -NoBrowser' -> renders tool catalog directly in console

MACRO: set-tool-audience
- description: configure whether a tool is User-exposed or Developer-only
- syntax: set-tool-audience | @set-tool-audience
- note: Tool audience, role, and metadata are maintained interactively directly within the ToolExplorer application (or via Update-ToolCatalog.ps1)

MACRO: log
- description: locate and open latest LCM log file and reveal full log history in File Explorer
- syntax: log [ToolName] | logs [ToolName]
- aliases: log, logs, lastlog

---
name: ReviewCommitGovernancePolicy
description: Authoritative governance policy for Review-Gated Commits, Completion with Edits, and Forced Commit Overrides.
globs: "*"
---
# File: ReviewCommitGovernancePolicy.md

Module: ReviewCommitGovernancePolicy  
Purpose: Defines mandatory review-gated commit rules, review disposition handling, authorized bypass exceptions, audit logging, and single-session directory junction reviews.  
Path: .agents/rules/ReviewCommitGovernancePolicy.md  
Authors: Rolf, LCM_AI Governance  
Version: 10.0.1
Status: Authoritative Policy  
Date: 2026-10-13

---

## 1. Governance Rules

### RULE-REV-001: Mandatory Review-Gated Commits & Gate 2 Non-Circumvention Invariant
1. **Mandatory Visual Review Gate (Gate 2)**: Every Git commit action for source code, configuration, tools, modules, or structural assets (`*.ps1`, `*.psm1`, `.vscode/settings.json`, `LCM_Inventory/*`, `docs/*`) in any LCM-governed repository requires a prior validated review disposition (`COMPLETED` or `COMPLETED_WITH_EDITS`) produced via the formal Beyond Compare 5 visual review gate (`Invoke-BeyondCompareReview.ps1`), with transparent junction traversal via `FollowSymLinks` (`RULE-REV-008`). The gate may resolve an exact CRP/BUG, a repository, or a declared cohort; it must reject only unresolved or ambiguous scope.
2. **Strict Gate 2 Non-Circumvention Baseline**: Beyond Compare visual diff review is non-circumventable for code/tools/specs across all items by default. Even critical, urgent, or internally generated BUGs normally execute in `DOIT` mode (`always-proceed = $true`) without a Gate 1 planning pause, but halt at Gate 2 for operator review before reaching `COMMITTED`.
3. **Authorized Exceptions to Gating**:
   There are two (2) authorized exceptions to this rule:
   1. **Explicit Operator Directive (`IMMEDIATELY`, `FORCE`)**: The user can explicitly INSTRUCT (`IMMEDIATELY`, `FORCE`) to bypass review confirmation and advance directly into the Implementation Phase / review commit without confirming the visual review.
   2. **Critical Flow-Impeding BUG & Loop Breaker**: The system has detected a BUG that impedes the intended flow in a critical manner, especially when the task would lead to an unavoidable loop or recursion that the user cannot circumvent or fix. In this scenario, the system may proceed autonomously, engaging `-MinimalTests` to prevent cascading test recursions, but there `MUST BE NO MORE THAN TWO (2) ATTEMPTS` to resolve the issue before halting.
   - **Mandatory Audit Logging Invariant**: In either exception case, the fact, rationale, and specific trigger `MUST` be explicitly documented in the accompanying `BUG` or `CRP` proposal bundle and recorded in the Configuration Management ledger.
   - **Quality Gate, Syntax & Language Non-Bypass Invariant**: Taking an authorized exception to bypass manual visual review strictly waives only the interactive visual diff inspection step. It `MUST NEVER` bypass, waive, or relax syntax validation (PowerShell AST parser checks, Python compilation), language rules ([`LanguagePolicy.md`](file:///d:/Git_Repositories/.agents/rules/LanguagePolicy.md) English invariant), or baseline repository readiness quality gates (`Test-RepoReadiness.ps1`). All modified files `MUST` compile cleanly with zero syntax errors and satisfy all language and formatting invariants prior to commit.
4. **Exemption Scope**: Generated artifacts, scratch content, data, logs, and routine test output
   defined in `RULE-EFF-001` are exempt from mandatory visual review gating. BCR may inspect
   them unfiltered on request and may emit helpful advisory findings, but those findings do not
   create a review gate.
5. **BCompare Materiality Authority**: Beyond Compare is the sole authority for whether a difference is material. The review launcher MUST enable its insignificant-difference controls. The left pane is a read-only baseline; the operator accepts or rejects the live right-pane worktree on review exit, and any live-pane edits are recorded as "accepted with changes". Raw-byte, Git-diff, line-ending, or whitespace comparisons MUST NOT create review candidates or obstruct review disposition.
6. **Non-Interactive / Headless Environment Fallback**: If Beyond Compare 5 or Session 1 interactive GUI execution is physically unavailable (e.g. running inside a headless CI/CD runner, container, or non-GUI remote SSH terminal), the agent `SHALL` present unified console diffs alongside the proposal's `Walkthrough.md` verification evidence for explicit terminal disposition before committing.

### RULE-REV-002: Completed with Edits Qualification
When a review outcome is recorded as `Completed with Edits` (or `Completed with Change`):
1. The modified codebase `MUST` execute and satisfy all repository quality gates (`Test-RepoReadiness.ps1`).
2. The modifications `MUST NOT` introduce rule violations, regression errors, or broken dependencies.
3. Upon satisfying all quality gates, the state `SHALL` be classified as fully `COMPLETED` and committed to Git.
4. When `-MinimalTests` is engaged under operator instruction or automated loop circumvention, the readiness gate executes fast-tier syntax and structure validation while bypassing heavy integration cascades; the resulting commit is recorded as `completed [minimal-tests]` with `"test_scope": "minimal"` per `RULE-LCM-023`.

### RULE-REV-003: Override & Force Authority for Rejected/Deferred States
If a review outcome is `REJECTED` or `DEFERRED`:
1. Automated commit and push pipelines `MUST` halt immediately.
2. Committing or pushing changes in a rejected or deferred state `IS FORBIDDEN` unless explicitly commanded by the user with a forced override instruction (e.g., `-Force` parameter or unambiguous explicit override prompt).

# Implementation Plan: CRP-305 - Coordinated standard display freshness contract

## 1. Executive Summary & Problem Context
Operator selected Option B: shared freshness contract for coordinated display synchronization. Cover relevant data and presentation inputs, completion-aware publication, open-view reconciliation, visible stale/error states and snapshot preservation, reusing existing daemon notification infrastructure.

## 2. Gate 0 Traceability
- Dependency/revision inventory and shared coordination: criteria 1-4, 9.
- Open-view delivery, truthful status and refresh repairs: criteria 5-7.
- Snapshot safeguards: criterion 8.
- End-to-end validation and source atomization: criteria 10-11.
- Exclusive port-9876 page/asset/data delivery and outage behavior: criteria 12-13.

## 3. Proposed Changes
1. Inventory included display dependencies, governed mutation paths, existing
   routes and view-state persistence. Record known coverage gaps before editing.
2. Extract/reuse daemon revision/publication and event-delivery services in
   small focused components. Define operation status and atomic publication.
   Provide same-origin display/asset/data routes on port 9876; migrate local-file
   launches and remove ShowCM's existing offline file fallback.
3. Integrate ShowTools first: catalog synchronization, source and presentation
   invalidation, open-view delivery, recovery and explicit failure states.
4. Integrate Rules, Workspace Inventory, Control Hub and Dates data refresh using
   that same contract rather than duplicating refresh logic.
5. Label snapshot-only viewers and preserve selected historical evidence;
   ensure no auto-refresh path launches evidence producers.
6. Add focused tests and update related documentation/registrations. Reach
   exact-item review checkpoints in bounded increments; no automatic commit.

## 4. Verification Plan
- Unit/contract tests for dependency fingerprints, data/presentation distinction,
  missing/deleted inputs, coalescing, operation state and atomic publication.
- Failure tests: process starts but fails, slow render, malformed output,
  unreachable daemon, lost event/reconnect and out-of-order publication.
- Browser verification with an already-open view: add/edit/rename/remove a
  fixture tool; verify exact rendered revision and preserved user state.
- Verify shared template/script changes invalidate affected presentation;
  unrelated inputs do not trigger unnecessary regeneration.
- Verify no watcher-generated output loop, daemon request-loop blocking or
  implicit analysis/test/privileged execution.
- AST/JavaScript syntax, encoding and smallest focused existing regressions.
- Browser network/navigation assertions: all Standard Display delivery uses
  port 9876; no file: requests, temp/profile HTML launches or alternate-port
  fallbacks. Daemon recovery failure must report an error without opening files.

# Standard Display Delivery and Freshness

Module: LcmDisplayCoordinator
Authors: Rolf, Copilot
Version: 10.0.1
Date: 2026-10-21

## Delivery

Standard Displays open through the existing daemon at
`http://127.0.0.1:9876` only. The live routes are `/tools`, `/rules`,
`/inventory`, `/hub` and `/dates`. Styles, scripts and data use the same
origin. Browser-facing `file:` URLs, user-profile HTML launches, alternate
ports and daemon-offline file fallbacks are not supported.

Generated artifacts and evidence still exist on disk as backend inputs and
retained outputs. Their existence is not an instruction to open them directly.
The daemon serves allowlisted routes, not arbitrary filesystem paths.

After updating the daemon sources, restart the existing daemon to load the
new modules. The `/ping` response advertises `standardDisplays: 1`; launchers
refuse an older daemon explicitly rather than falling back to files.
The shared launcher makes one existing-daemon recovery attempt if offline.

## Live revisions

The [dependency manifest](../modules/LcmDisplayDependencies.psm1) declares
data and presentation inputs separately. Catalog discovery locations are
shared with the catalog generator, including child-owned tool sources.
Inventory documentation and proposal documents are dependencies too.

Each open view reconciles its dependency revision on startup, focus,
reconnection, explicit Refresh and periodic status requests. Content hashes
detect edits, creates, renames and deletions, even with unchanged file times.
No additional service or whole-disk watcher is introduced. Poll requests are
coalesced; fingerprint checks are rate-limited.

The coordinator starts only a fixed allowlisted renderer in a child process.
It does not wait in the HTTP request loop for rendering to finish.
`Updating` is not `Current`: only a successful, validated output is published.
Presentation/source changes during a render invalidate that result. A failed
or timed-out render preserves the previous published bytes, reports `Failed`
and identifies its operation log. Explicit Refresh retries; a new input
revision can also recover a failed publication.

Status and content responses use `Cache-Control: no-store`. A content revision
header prevents applying bytes from a different publication than the status
being reconciled. Data adapters update the current view in place; a changed
presentation revision triggers a controlled HTTP reload with view state
preservation. There is no fixed delay interpreted as successful refresh.

The visible status distinguishes Current, Updating, Stale, Failed and
Disconnected. Daemon connectivity alone never certifies current display data.
An already-open disconnected view may retain its last delivered content,
clearly marked; it does not open a local cached HTML file.

## Retained evidence

Failure-analysis, functional-analysis and readiness reports are historical
snapshots. Their HTML is served under an opaque retained snapshot route on
port 9876. Opening or reloading a snapshot does not run an analysis, audit,
readiness test or privileged command. Source evidence and its collection time
remain authoritative for what the report observed, not current system state.

## Operations

- Launch existing commands such as `ShowTools`, `ShowRules` and `ShowCM`.
- Refresh uses `/displays/refresh/{id}` and observes completion through
  `/displays/status/{id}`; `DISPATCHED` is never considered publication.
- Publication logs are under `data\logs\displays`, keyed by display and
  operation ID.
- The daemon must remain available on port 9876. A failed recovery or missing
  route is an explicit error, not permission to use a file-based display.

Existing tabs opened with `file:` before this upgrade must be closed and
reopened once through their command. The daemon cannot replace a browser page
that was loaded from an unrelated filesystem origin. Subsequent revisions of
the HTTP-delivered view reconcile automatically.

+    $missing = Get-LcmDisplayFingerprint @($pattern)

+# Standard Display Delivery and Freshness
+
+Module: LcmDisplayCoordinator
+Authors: Rolf, Copilot
+Version: 10.0.1
+Date: 2026-10-21
+
+## Delivery
+
+Standard Displays open through the existing daemon at
+`http://127.0.0.1:9876` only. The live routes are `/tools`, `/rules`,
+`/inventory`, `/hub` and `/dates`. Styles, scripts and data use the same
+origin. Browser-facing `file:` URLs, user-profile HTML launches, alternate
+ports and daemon-offline file fallbacks are not supported.
+
+Generated artifacts and evidence still exist on disk as backend inputs and
+retained outputs. Their existence is not an instruction to open them directly.
+The daemon serves allowlisted routes, not arbitrary filesystem paths.
+
+After updating the daemon sources, restart the existing daemon to load the
+new modules. The `/ping` response advertises `standardDisplays: 1`; launchers
+refuse an older daemon explicitly rather than falling back to files.
+The shared launcher makes one existing-daemon recovery attempt if offline.
+
+## Live revisions
+
+The [dependency manifest](../modules/LcmDisplayDependencies.psm1) declares
+data and presentation inputs separately. Catalog discovery locations are
+shared with the catalog generator, including child-owned tool sources.
+Inventory documentation and proposal documents are dependencies too.
+
+Each open view reconciles its dependency revision on startup, focus,
+reconnection, explicit Refresh and periodic status requests. Content hashes
+detect edits, creates, renames and deletions, even with unchanged file times.
+No additional service or whole-disk watcher is introduced. Poll requests are
+coalesced; fingerprint checks are rate-limited.
+
+The coordinator starts only a fixed allowlisted renderer in a child process.
+It does not wait in the HTTP request loop for rendering to finish.
+`Updating` is not `Current`: only a successful, validated output is published.
+Presentation/source changes during a render invalidate that result. A failed
+or timed-out render preserves the previous published bytes, reports `Failed`
+and identifies its operation log. Explicit Refresh retries; a new input
+revision can also recover a failed publication.
+
+Status and content responses use `Cache-Control: no-store`. A content revision
+header prevents applying bytes from a different publication than the status
+being reconciled. Data adapters update the current view in place; a changed
+presentation revision triggers a controlled HTTP reload with view state
+preservation. There is no fixed delay interpreted as successful refresh.
+
+The visible status distinguishes Current, Updating, Stale, Failed and
+Disconnected. Daemon connectivity alone never certifies current display data.
+An already-open disconnected view may retain its last delivered content,
+clearly marked; it does not open a local cached HTML file.
+
+## Retained evidence
+
+Failure-analysis, functional-analysis and readiness reports are historical
+snapshots. Their HTML is served under an opaque retained snapshot route on
+port 9876. Opening or reloading a snapshot does not run an analysis, audit,
+readiness test or privileged command. Source evidence and its collection time
+remain authoritative for what the report observed, not current system state.
+
+## Operations
+
+- Launch existing commands such as `ShowTools`, `ShowRules` and `ShowCM`.
+- Refresh uses `/displays/refresh/{id}` and observes completion through
+  `/displays/status/{id}`; `DISPATCHED` is never considered publication.
+- Publication logs are under `data\logs\displays`, keyed by display and
+  operation ID.
+- The daemon must remain available on port 9876. A failed recovery or missing
+  route is an explicit error, not permission to use a file-based display.
